'''Saara''' was a young girl born around the time of the [[Third Galactic War]]. Her [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Dantooine)|father]] was deeply in debts and joined the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang in order to pay them off. Saara was left alone with her mother and had just started talking at the time when they were harassed by the debt collectors.<ref>{{TORcite|Dantooine Incursion}}</ref>
